title: Daniel Thomason essays
subtitle: My essays on various topics: product management, how to live well, productivity, games, plus whatever else I find interesting.

posts.title: Your Customers Never Wanted a Relationship With You | Daniel Thomason
posts.description: People don't want relationships with brands; they want relationships with people. As AI agents take over our dealings with businesses, the fight to own the customer relationship gives way to a new goal: retaining the agent.

posts.title: The moral of "Whiplash" | Daniel Thomason
posts.description: I just watched Whiplash last night (writing this in October 2026). I enjoyed it. The moral is one I've pondered a few times: we collectively celebrate greatness, but prefer to avert our eyes from the process of becoming great.

posts.title: The Grasshopper and the Widget | Daniel Thomason
posts.description: A short economic fable, in the style of Aesop, about a grasshopper who discovers that the value of his work depends on countless hands he never sees.
